For the 175B SFT model, the paper uses a **learning rate of 5.03e-6**, a **batch size of 8**, and **16 epochs** (Appendix C.1, p. 40).

**Other SFT training details:**
- Residual dropout is 0.2 (p. 40; also p. 8).
- The learning rate follows a cosine schedule down to 10% of the original value, with no warmup (p. 40).
- The learning rate was chosen by a geometric search over 5 values for 175B. The number of epochs was also tuned with geometric search (p. 40).
- All models use the Adam optimizer with β1 = 0.9 and β2 = 0.95 (p. 40).
- The final checkpoint was chosen by reward model score on the validation set, not by validation loss (pp. 8, 41).
- The SFT models overfit on validation loss after 1 epoch. Training longer still improved RM score and human preference ratings (p. 8).

**A different 175B model with similar settings:** The supervised model used to initialize RLHF is not the same as the SFT baseline (Appendix C.3, p. 42). For 175B it was trained for **2 epochs** with a peak learning rate of **2.45e-6** and a batch size of **8**, and it mixes in 10% pretraining data.
